# F02 response — proposed resize and evidence focus

**Decision: F02 concurs with the two focus-dependent branches of `F01-RESIZE-FOCUS/0.1` as a proposal for the next joint candidate.** No incompatible shared component role was found. **Candidate.4 remains operative** until F01 publishes the new candidate, records the exact source delta and obtains affected-owner responses. This response preserves candidate.2 geometry and the existing candidate.4 concurrence; it neither silently amends those accepted inputs nor grants native, implementation, formal RIG or release acceptance.

## Exact input and review boundary

The proposal is [F01-RESIZE-FOCUS/0.1 at `abfecf1efc452383fe720cb3ea2016ad8d7088e0`](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/blob/abfecf1efc452383fe720cb3ea2016ad8d7088e0/research/design_candidates/production_design_20261102/f01/RESIZE_FOCUS_DECISION_PROPOSAL.md), Git blob `c5fcb502746843d10ce422ce3c1e35fcc1112a7f`. The current joint contract has whole-file blob `653d93bbce70a2515d677ecdb76bb21edfab750c`. Its **§§2–5 are byte-identical** to semantic freeze `8926b16af4e0c3e5310cdb4cf057390ec04d18ff`; §6 and status/binding history changed. [The exact comparison receipt](paper/reviews/f01-latest-source-readback-20261104.json) records that bounded equality.

Actual [source-contract review 5760649569](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10645#pullrequestreview-5760649569) remains bound to reviewed head `3e334bd3eabf1d6ecc7980845fbd7a813dd023e1` and its source scope. It does not approve this later proposal, revised conformance ledger, F01's later Directory implementation or any served Brain/native behavior. F02's [candidate.4 owner response6620137809](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10645#issuecomment-6620137809) remains unchanged. The [independent C3 source advisory](paper/reviews/f01-resize-concurrence-advisory-20261104.md) informed this owner decision and is not a formal reviewer receipt.

## Proposed component behavior

Capture legitimate focus ownership **before** hiding, detaching, changing inertness or moving the inspector. A later `BODY` active element cannot establish deliberate primary-task focus. The existing inspector owner retains one selected evidence object and one presentation; no second store, global event bus or lifecycle is introduced.

| Trigger and established ownership | Proposed F02 anatomy/accessibility contract | Preserved context |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Passive resize removes dock eligibility; inspector legitimately owns focus | Adapt the **same inspector** to modal. Keep its valid logical control; if that control no longer exists, use the existing named in-inspector fallback. Establish one modal trap, background inertness and active Escape owner coherently. | Exact domain identity, source generation, disclosure and local scroll remain valid. A placement change does not send focus back to the outside trigger. |
| Passive resize removes dock eligibility; user deliberately focused the primary task | Suspend inspector **presentation**, release reserved width and leave valid primary-task focus untouched. Expose an accessible, visible explicit **Reopen evidence** action through the existing trigger. | Retain domain selection and return anchor, primary input/selection/scroll and existing request state. No hidden modal or focused hidden control. Suspension does not discard selected evidence. |
| Width grows or oscillates while presentation is suspended | Stay suspended until explicit reopen. | No surprise opening, navigation preference reset or auto-compact rail. |
| Explicit Reopen evidence | Revalidate identity, access and source generation through incumbent owners, then choose the eligible presentation using measured usable width. | Existing domains own stale, missing, invalidated and denied outcomes. Do not reopen a stale object by position or silently choose another row. |
| Open modal becomes dock eligible | Adapt the same inspector to nonmodal; release its exclusive trap/inertness/scroll lock coherently while retaining a valid visible logical control. | Evidence identity, disclosure and scroll persist; do not restore the outside trigger merely because placement changed. |
| Another modal owns focus, or ownership is unknown | Apply existing shared-layer arbitration and hold the ambiguous automatic transition. | Neither branch may be inferred. No second modal, hidden focus, stale callback, delayed surprise opening or indefinitely invalid-width dock is accepted by this response; the existing owner must qualify this unresolved branch. |

Shared geometry stays **320px +24px gap with at least640px primary**, measured after actual shell, reserved chrome and gutters. A domain's larger qualified minimum still governs. D06's focused reader remains separate: 360px initial, requested300–520px clamp, actual price-plot fit and incumbent preference ownership. Brain Close remains distinct from Stop; `onClose` remains conditional; readiness, mounting and opener return do not establish visibility or closure. Resizing or suspension does not cancel a request, confirm Saved or retarget an already dispatched historical Ask.

## Exact versioned source changes on adoption

These are concrete successor edits, **not operative changes in this response**. Accepted `SYSTEM_CONTRACT.md` and `INTERACTION_STATES.md` policy bytes remain intact pending the new joint candidate.

| Existing clause | Required successor clarification |
| --- | --- |
| `SYSTEM_CONTRACT.md` §6: “Otherwise shared evidence is an overlay” | For explicitly opened evidence, choose eligible dock/modal presentation; for passive dock-eligibility loss, use the two ownership branches above. An intentionally suspended inspector stays suspended on width recovery. |
| `SYSTEM_CONTRACT.md` EvidenceInspector row and §6: combined “Close/placement change” return | Separate **dismissal** from **adaptation**. Dismissal restores an identity-based outside trigger only when the retiring surface legitimately owns focus, with named connected fallback. Adaptation retains a valid in-inspector logical control and context. Deliberate outside focus permits recoverable suspension without focus theft. |
| `INTERACTION_STATES.md` shared-inspector paragraph: “do not silently close” | Prohibit selection/context loss and unexplained disappearance. Permit presentation-only suspension for the established deliberate-primary-focus branch with a visible, explicit reopen action; keep retained identity and domain validation. |
| `F01_HANDSHAKE_CANDIDATE.md` responsive-mode-change row | Bind these branches and ownership snapshot order to the new joint version and exact owner responses. Keep current candidate.4 row as accepted historical/operative source until adoption. |

## Required affected qualification

Add facets to **existing N07/N10/N11/G07**, retaining their current status; do not create a second case registry or mark whole cases passed. Cover both threshold directions with inside focus; primary input focus then shrink; grow/oscillate while suspended; explicit reopen with valid/invalidated/denied identities; removed controls, rapid resizing, other active modal and delayed callbacks; and pending requests/saves across all presentation changes. Assert one inspector, correct focus/trap/inertness/scroll lock, identity/context retention, explicit recovery and unchanged owner outcomes. Real keyboard, touch, 400% zoom, reduced motion, themes/locales and domain paths remain unexecuted by this source response.

F01 owns composition/arbitration and the visible reopen affordance; F02 owns shared anatomy and accessibility qualification; D07/D08 and other adopting domains own selected-object/trigger validity and retained task context; D06 retains its focused-reader exception; Brain/D14 and the existing host retain visible lifecycle, request and callback lifetime. Their affected responses and exact next-version source, native and real-path evidence are still required. Neither F01's state-8/Readme holds nor F02's original Chinese operation is changed or cleared.

# F03 response — four-record Options presentation facet

**F03_CONCURRENCE_SCOPED_V1 — source/design concurrence only.** F03 concurs with the proposed **Options & futures / 期权与期货** grouping for exactly the four existing identities below, subject to the incumbent exporter/domain/access and interaction conditions in this response. This is not approval of all 290 category proposals, a runtime release, a route-admission decision, translation release or RIG receipt. No proposal was automatically applied.

## Exact reviewed input

- [F01 presentation proposal](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/blob/abfecf1efc452383fe720cb3ea2016ad8d7088e0/research/design_candidates/production_design_20261102/f01/DIRECTORY_PRESENTATION_PROPOSAL.json), source head `abfecf1efc452383fe720cb3ea2016ad8d7088e0`, blob `1fb186e2efc0f6270e32f95b3cca92f2971fcb7c`.
- [Existing F03 qualification request](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10631#issuecomment-6617498900).
- [F01 actual-baseline follow-up](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10631#issuecomment-6618981006), reporting 12 `options` matches: four platform destinations, seven learning pages and one calculator. F03 read the source/comment; it did not repeat that browser observation.

| Existing ID | Exact destination | Origin | Retained payload tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `terminal:options_futures` | `/options/futures` | native | `premium` |
| `terminal:options` | `/options` | native | `unknown` |
| `macro:options` | `/options.html` | legacy | `public_shell_premium_payload` |
| `macro:options_screener` | `/options_screener.html` | legacy | `public_shell_premium_payload` |

Their exact identity/path/access fields also agree with F03's frozen route projection. Native/legacy describes origin, not current/obsolete status. Keep all paths visible; do not deduplicate by label, translation or extension. Only `macro:options` has the source-labelled United States qualifier. The three new literal Chinese nouns remain proposed labels; no expanded market/coverage/access meaning is inferred.

## Required search semantics

The proposal's literal baseline href/title/question text probe finds four `options` records; it is not sufficient to reproduce the separately observed 12-match live corpus. The proposal must not replace the incumbent search corpus, add a four-result cap or silently create aliases.

Use the incumbent eligibility/access result set and search semantics first, then apply this presentation facet by exact ID. Derive both facet and total counts from the same eligible query snapshot. **Show all N matches clears only the category**, preserves the query and other applicable context, and restores the complete eligible result set. Twelve is a fixture observation, never a constant.

## Tests still required before interaction/runtime acceptance

1. The observed fixture yields four platform results under the facet and restores all 12 matches, including seven learning pages and the calculator, without clearing `options`.
2. A new matching learning result changes the total/reset count without becoming a platform category member. Zero facet matches with nonzero overall results has a clear category-only recovery.
3. Identity, exact destination, access and payload behavior remain unchanged. Unknown stays unknown; public shell/premium payload is not collapsed into fully public or fully paid.
4. Query, locale, unrelated filters/sort and intended focus survive reset. A browse facet does not change global navigation `aria-current`.
5. EN/ZH input follows incumbent search rules; do not force equal counts or silently approve proposed aliases.
6. Loading, read errors, stale results and access changes preserve truthful source/count states. Keyboard/touch/focus paths and the 44px reset target must be exercised.

These runtime tests are NOT_RUN by F03. Source/native fixtures and this concurrence do not substitute for the existing exporter/domain owner's implementation/qualification.

## Design-package distinction

D08A Overview/Flow, D08B Exposure/Volatility/3D, D08C Plan/Compare/Review and D08D Futures/Equity Replay are **four separately owned design packages**, not a one-to-one mapping to the four route IDs. A route may consume several packages; a package may cover several views. Equity replay remains a separately recorded source delta with no canonical ID invented by F03. The new F03 Options entry links design packages and exact source returns without admitting or implementing routes.

All 290 proposal records remain in their existing review process; this response closes only the requested F03 position on the four-member grouping and category-reset contract. Existing hold, final joint-foundation, native/reference and product-proof gates remain.
